decisions.rationale: The route is real and explicitly supported in Figure 1a and its caption as part of OCellus pretraining. The narrow correction is to stop treating the model-visible form and topology as more specific than the paper supports: the paper shows tokenized PPI database text flowing through an encoder and into a Qwen-aligned backbone, but it does not justify the prior scaffold subtype or shared-latent topology label.
